design_directives.hero_section: Light, airy landscape with soft pale horizon, golden wheat field, overlay of cream tint. Dark green typography for high contrast readability. Strictly NO human figures.
design_directives.crops_section: Close-up rich textured wheat ears and field rows. Natural earthy greens and warm golden hues. Strictly NO human faces or bodies.
design_directives.hero_alt: Serene morning dawn landscape with light mist over agricultural fields.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always maintain WCAG AA contrast against text.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Never use dark blanket overlays that obscure light hero landscape.
